name: cadwork
notes: cadwork Knowledgebase 'News' overview - only documents major YEARLY releases (2025, 2026, ...), not individual builds like 33.0.63. cadwork does not publish build-level changes publicly (confirmed on their own download pages: build info is only shown inside the software itself via 'Mitteilungszentrale'). This is a known, accepted limitation.

name: Allplan 2026
notes: Tracks only the 2026 branch (newest 2026 release/hotfix). Kept separate from 2025 because Allplan continues shipping hotfixes for the previous year's branch in parallel.

name: Allplan 2025
notes: Tracks only the 2025 branch (newest 2025 release/hotfix), independently from 2026. Same overview page as allplan_2026, just filtered to a different year in the URL.

name: Rhino (McNeel)
notes: The main rhino3d.com site renders its changelog via JavaScript and cannot be read with a plain HTTP request. Instead this tracks the McNeel forum thread where every new Service Release is posted as a reply. Uses Discourse's public JSON API (topic.json + posts/by_number). When Rhino 9 becomes current, McNeel will likely start an equivalent new thread - update topic_url/topic_id then.

name: Dlubal RFEM/RSTAB (Build-Alarm)
notes: Uses Discourse's public JSON API (append .json to any route) instead of scraping HTML. community.dlubal.com only fully server-renders HTML for verified crawlers, and spoofing a Googlebot User-Agent was not reliably honored (likely intercepted by a firewall/CDN in front of Discourse). The JSON API is not subject to that gating and works the same way regardless of caller identity. NOTE: these posts just announce 'new build available, see Release Notes' - the actual detailed changes are behind a login-gated Dlubal Extranet page and are not publicly accessible. This source is a fast 'something shipped' alarm with limited content; see dlubal_whats_new for a more descriptive (but less frequent) alternative.

name: Dlubal RFEM/RSTAB (What's New, monatlich)
notes: Dlubal's monthly 'What's New' round-up posts. Roughly once a month instead of every build, but contains actual named features (e.g. 'Modal analysis values by FE node', 'Wind flows using point clouds') instead of a generic 'bugfixes available' announcement - this is the most detailed public content Dlubal publishes.

name: Dlubal Extranet Release Notes (Login)
notes: Uses the user's own Dlubal account (DLUBAL_USER/DLUBAL_PASS secrets) via a real headless browser (Playwright) to log in and read the 'Implemented Features' table, which is not publicly accessible. Jumping straight to the viewpage=126 URL did not work (the single-page app didn't load real content on a direct external navigation) - clicks through the real menus instead: Development -> Implemented Features.
